description.value: Corsa Cycles is a full-service bicycle shop in Squamish, BC, now operating under the Dunbar Cycles & Corsa Cycles banner following its 2018 acquisition. The shop covers mountain, road, gravel, city, and electric bikes alongside a dedicated service centre, making it a comprehensive stop in the Sea-to-Sky corridor. Its broad parts and accessories inventory—including touring-specific luggage and racks—makes it particularly useful for loaded cycle tourers passing through Squamish.
